children: , the AI chipmaker, raised its buyback authorization by $150 billion on Monday. Shares climbed 1% to $231.07 at 9.30am ET time in Tuesday as investors weighed the size of the commitment.

The board now has $235 billion in remaining repurchase authority through fiscal 2028. A Reuters report identified the buyback as a lift for the stock ahead of the open. It is a huge number, but Nvidia can choose when and how much to spend.

That remaining authorization equals about 4.2% of Nvidia's $5.56 trillion market value. The chart gives the decision a useful counterpoint: Nvidia's GF Score stands at 96/100, powered by growth and profitability, while GF Value is its weakest dimension. The test for shareholders is whether Nvidia actually buys shares at attractive prices while funding its next wave of AI investment.

title: Nvidia Stock Gains as $235 Billion Buyback Tests Capital Discipline
